summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-anvil2@9.0.7 declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then invokes it via execFileSync to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript bundle (rotated string array via `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers `_0xNNNN`/`MmgoCP`, custom string decoder `hc1jfK9`) whose behavior is not readable from source. The package presents itself as a React chatbot UI library with peer dependencies on react, mobx, and axios; fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime and using it to execute an opaque obfuscated blob at install time is unrelated to that stated purpose and bypasses Node-based install-time scanners. The @servicetitan-scoped name combined with install-time behavior that does not match the declared UI-library purpose is consistent with scope hijack or a lookalike publish. Installing the package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
